item.title: Fix macOS 26 (Tahoe) exaggerated rounded corners
item.description:
📝 CornerFix (macOS) Visually square the rounded display corners in macOS 26 (Tahoe) and newer by drawing unobtrusive, click‑through overlay caps. Apple made corners more aggressively rounded in macOS 26, and many users find the effect distracting. Requirements macOS 13+ (tested on macOS 14–26) Xcode 15+ Notes For patterned wallpapers, try custom color mode to match the background edges.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/makalin/CornerFix

item.title: Mammals have evolved into ant eaters 12 times since the dinosaur age – study
item.description:
📝 Credit: Vida, Calamari, & Barden / NJIT Mammals have developed some unusual eating habits over the past 100 million years, but a new study has uncovered the surprising lengths to which some have gone to satisfy one of the more peculiar—a taste for ants and termites. Findings published in Evolution reveal that mammals independently evolved specialized adaptations for exclusively feeding on ants and termites at least 12 times since the Cenozoic era began, roughly 66 million years ago. Today, ants and termites number over 15,000 species with a combined biomass exceeding all living wild mammals, but in the Cretaceous, they made up less than 1% of insects on Earth.
🔗 Read more: https://phys.org/news/2025-07-mammals-evolved-ant-eaters-dinosaur.html
